name: XPS emu
description: Native original Xbox emulator for PS5 based on xemu. Features Vulkan rendering through RADV, DualSense support for up to four players, an Xbox-style game library with cover art, per-game settings, game patches, language selection, save repair and USB game support. Requires your own legally obtained Xbox MCPX boot ROM, BIOS and XISO game images.
author: AZiZ
